title: WHAT IF YOU HAD 5 CLONES OF YOURSELF? 👥😱 (Animated Short Film)
description:
Deep in an abandoned biotechnology laboratory, Pip discovers an experimental human replication chamber. With a single prick of his thumb, five exact biological copies step out of the glowing green mist. Same hoodie. Same voice. Same memories. But unlike Pip... these five were starving to work.

For three glorious months, Pip lives like a digital god: Clone 1 triples their bank account working corporate finance, Clone 2 sculpts six-pack abs, and Clone 3 masters quantum physics, while Pip lounges on the couch playing video games.

Then in Month 4, paradise rots. The clones stop making eye contact. Whispers echo through the kitchen. And Pip wakes up bound to a steel folding chair under a single flickering spotlight...

💬 THE ULTIMATE EXISTENTIAL DILEMMA:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
The clones have voted unanimously that the original Pip is obsolete:
👉 Option A: "TERMINATE ALL 5 CLONES — Press the emergency kill switch and return to doing all the work alone."
👉 Option B: "SURRENDER YOUR CONTROL — Let the superior clones run your life while you live in total secrecy."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
